overall_notes: The paper focuses on text detoxification as an NLG task. Extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant or incorrectly categorized items. Paper uses standard automatic metrics (Perspective API, BLEU, BERTScore, Perplexity, J score) and conducts human evaluation focused on toxicity and fluency. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is performed.
